## About

I'm Markonda Santhosh Kumar, a B.Tech Computer Science (AI & Data Science) student based in Hyderabad, India. I'm a Java full stack developer. My focus is Java, Spring Boot, REST APIs and SQL on the backend, with React on the frontend. I'm currently learning Spring Microservices, Generative AI, AWS and Docker.
